title: Show HN: Ito – Build Terminal UIs in Lua
summary: Two Neovim enthusiasts created Ito, a terminal UI framework built in Lua, as an alternative to JavaScript-based solutions like Bubble Tea (Pi). The project aims to provide a minimal, customizable harness for building beautiful terminal interfaces with native Lua support, with potential Rust integration for performance.
problem_solved: Provides a Lua-native solution for building terminal user interfaces, eliminating the need to use JavaScript or other languages that don't integrate well with the Neovim/Lua ecosystem.
why_valuable: Enables Lua developers to build customizable terminal UIs using familiar tooling, maintaining consistency with Neovim workflows and configuration patterns.
